verdict.rationale: Riveter publishes a documented REST API (endpoints like /enrich, /runs/{id}, /datasets, scrape, quick_search, search_agent, webhook_url, dry_run, max_credits), an OpenAPI spec, and an official Go SDK, making it clearly drivable programmatically by AI-native users. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and the probe couldn't verify a machine-readable openapi.json/llms.txt (only openapi.yaml is referenced).
